implementation.targetScope: OrderedMap 2.1.1 public string-key API and ProseMirror schema callers. Private backing sequence, lazy large-map lookup index, linear bulk edits.

changes: Copy own enumerable input properties only; inherited properties do not become schema entries.
Preserve __proto__ as an own data property in ordinary object output.
Allow explicit empty-string renaming; preserve previous maps through all edits.
Build bulk subtraction and merge in one pass instead of repeated remove/copy operations.
Cache lookups for maps with at least 32 entries; ordinary small schemas retain compact scans.
Avoid allocation for identical-value updates; private storage cannot be modified through the old undocumented content field.
